entry.title: New: RES24-080 (Honolulu) — CCL
entry.content:
AMENDING RESOLUTION 17-221, CD1, AS AMENDED BY RESOLUTION 20-170, CD1, AS FURTHER AMENDED BY RESOLUTION 23-272, CD1, TO FURTHER EXTEND THE DEADLINE TO OBTAIN A BUILDING PERMIT FOR AN INTERIM PLANNED DEVELOPMENT-TRANSIT PROJECT LOCATED AT 1500 KAPI‘OLANI BOULEVARD, AND TO APPROVE CERTAIN PROJECT MODIFICATIONS.

Latest action: Committee report and Resolution as amended were adopted.
